scope: CadQuery/OpenCascade tessellation of fully filleted planar thumb-holder bodies
observation: A controlled relaxation of both OCC tessellation tolerances brought all four manufacturing meshes below the declared triangle budget while independent topology audits remained PASS.
hypothesis: The initial 0.06 mm / 0.12 rad tessellation over-sampled the repeated 1 mm fillets and obround boundaries relative to the 0.4 mm nozzle manufacturing resolution.
alternatives: Reduce the number or scope of analytic fillets.
Use local tessellation settings if the export toolchain gains deterministic per-face controls.
Retain finer tessellation for appearance-critical surfaces with a higher declared artifact budget.
uncertainty: One geometry family and one OCC export configuration; no surface-deviation benchmark or physical print comparison was performed.
